name: The panel opens, two typed letters find the app, and Return opens it

media.caption: The panel opens, two typed letters find the app, the field completes its name, and Return opens it.
media.alt: A recording of Slick's search panel in dark mode over a purple gradient wallpaper. The panel opens and suggests Mail, Calendar and Music. Typing “n” lists News, Notes, a window command, two web searches, TextEdit and Sleep. Typing “o” selects Notes and completes the field to “notes”, with the rest of the name in grey, above TextEdit, Console, Font Book, Screenshot, Mission Control and System Information. Return picks Notes and the panel closes. The scenario notes the launch instead of opening the app. Recorded from the assembled app running a scripted scenario, with Apple's own apps and their real icons.
